abertura.chamada: Active prospecting for any service provider.

apresentacao.subtitulo: While your ad waits for someone to show up, ProspectX goes to the companies that need your service right now — with phone and email, ready to contact.
apresentacao.ctaObservacao: Works without signing up. You see real companies before deciding.
apresentacao.passo1Titulo: Tell us your trade and where you work
apresentacao.passo1Texto: Stonemason in Austin, sandblasting in Houston, whatever it is. Accepts neighbourhoods too, so leads stay close to you.
apresentacao.passo2Titulo: Get the companies that hire you
apresentacao.passo2Texto: Not a list of competitors. The system knows a stonemason sells to builders and architects — and that's what it looks for.
apresentacao.passo3Texto: WhatsApp with the message ready, one click per company. Or email up to 50 at once, with your portfolio attached.
apresentacao.contaTitulo: Do the math before you look at the price
apresentacao.contaTexto: What is a new client worth to you? If one job closes at $4,000 and ProspectX costs $37 a month, closing a single one per month already paid for the tool 100 times over.
apresentacao.contaRodape: That's why the trial is 7 days, no strings: enough time to find out whether it closes.
apresentacao.difEsperarTexto: You pay to be visible and hope someone searches at exactly the right moment.
apresentacao.difIrTexto: You pick the trade and the area, and get companies with contact details. The direction is reversed.
apresentacao.planosTitulo: Founder pricing for the first ones in
apresentacao.planosTexto: The first spots lock the price for life. After that, standard pricing applies.

busca.modoDiretaDescricao: Search directly for what you're looking for
busca.placeholderRamoDireta: e.g. builder, hospital, restaurant — what do you need to hire?

busca.dicaBairro: In large cities, start with the neighbourhood: "Downtown, Austin, TX". Leads stay close to you and your credits go further.
busca.dicaCreditos: Larger searches return more companies per credit spent. Whatever is left over never expires: it adds to your next top-up.
